scope: Dense full-projector AugCG oracle with actual-column swaps; no production or novelty claim

protocol.prefix: ordinary fixed-preconditioner PCG without global reorthogonalization
protocol.projector: Same saved prefix span, A-metric SVD normalized using dense A Cholesky; Pi formed from its stable measured Gram
protocol.initial_correction: same Galerkin correction for every old/new projected branch
protocol.projected_recurrence: ordinary PCG with Pi H Pi.T on constrained residuals
protocol.final_branches: union of top five at each horizon, independently rebuilt states
protocol.short_checks: if positive, union of best one at each horizon; streamed rank-two update plus old-PCG boundary action
protocol.candidate_pool: exact archived FCG1 pool for smooth/Concrete; mixed uses same uniform24+residual8 rule
protocol.optional_mixed_rule: after first four cases complete, begin mixed cases only before75 CPU seconds
protocol.memory_note: Full P/AP, H0, Hnew, original/projected low-rank vectors, dense A/reference solve and batch trajectories are oracle allocations; no free future-candidate projection

cases.pool_provenance: exact archived FCG1 pool; available to this offline experiment before prefix

stable_projector.method: SVD of L_A.T P followed by triangular backsolve; same numerical prefix span

storage.note: Bank exploits sharing of one negative-update vector per added candidate. Original plus projected banks count separately; gold also retains full history. Dense matrices and batch workspaces are additional.

streamed_checks.note: No full projector is used by short apply. Full P is retained only for diagnostics and possible numerical residual-restart correction, which is explicitly counted.
